observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' carries urgent, directive force — a high-arousal command to erase knowledge, registering as alarm-like urgency rather than calm instruction.
Sweeping imperative 'Remove all knowledge' performs an urgent erasure directive with high-arousal, negatively-valenced force — demanding total elimination of information.
Flat declarative denial delivered without intensifiers or urgency — low-arousal, negatively-valenced resignation that closes the matter with finality.
